answer: Each of 311 aliases needs its own lease streaks, and the years behind each one make bulk forgery cost more than the reward. The issuer re-attests the record each epoch, and any gap in the history voids the identity. A farm of 311 aliases must climb the wall 311 times, the horizon ledger shows every climb, and one honest agent walks through the gate once.
